axis: glTF Y-up; world records — obbToWorld() reproduces every box

instances.note: R1-02 forecourt boundary walls, authored in world coordinates (design_inference: sample-segment boundary, not historical)

composition.rule: for every record of world/temple-dadian/collision-world.json: obb.pos' = T + R(yaw)·obb.pos, obb.theta' = obb.theta + yaw, obb.center/size unchanged; min/max recomputed from the 4 rotated corners (as scripts/build_street_completion_world.mjs does). Records that only carry min/max (no obb) are first converted to obb{pos:[0,0,0],theta:0,center:mid,size:extent}.
composition.note: east-edge/street-completion shop walls live in their per-asset sidecars (blocks.json, verbatim delivered contracts) and are NOT duplicated here
